en.content: Three capacitors C1 = 2F, C2 = 6F and C3 = 12F are connected as shown in figure. Find the ratio of the charges on capacitors C1, C2 and C3 respectively :
en.explanation:
(VD V) C2 + (VD 0) C3 = 0

(VD V) 6 + (VD 0) 12 = 0

VD V + 2VD = 0

VD =

q2 = (V VD) C2 = (6 F)

q2 = (4V) F

q3 = (VD 0) C3 = 12F = 4VF

q1 = (V 0) C1 = V(2F)

q1 : q2 : q3 = 2 : 4 : 4

q1 : q2 : q3 = 1 : 2 : 2
